purpose: Create leakage-resistant human structural gold for public-domain heldout literary passages while preserving ambiguity and preventing the extractor from seeing adjudication evidence.
rules: The selected work must exist in PUBLIC-DOMAIN-SOURCE-HELDOUT-MANIFEST-v1.json and remain TEST_ONLY.
The passage locator must identify the bounded source location without requiring the repository to store an entire book body.
The source SHA-256 must bind the exact passage text used for both model inference and human adjudication.
Gold labels and forbidden labels must never be serialized into the model request.
Ambiguous chronology, perspective, causality, identity or function may use multiple allowed alternatives or UNRESOLVED; adjudicators must not force one asserted answer merely for scoring convenience.
A disagreement that cannot be resolved by source evidence remains an explicit disagreement/UNRESOLVED case rather than fabricated consensus.
Human adjudication is structural evidence only; it does not authorize manuscript mutation, author intent, publication or canon change.
completion_rule: A heldout case is scorable only after exact source digest, passage locator, human gold, ambiguity/disagreement state and prediction-freeze evidence are complete.
